I need to focus on creating a code module for a diorama of an Arctic research outpost using TS. I need to ensure that there are no unsupported calls while building the Arctic scene. I’ll use functions like createBuilder, b.part, b.stick, b.sweep, and potentially b.extrude and b.lathe.
